matching: word-start regex; a concept counts only with a strong hit, or a weak hit confirmed in the same step by a strong hit or an operations-vocabulary noun (generic context or a selected industry pack) that is not itself a keyword match; weak never confirms weak; any negative word -> human; negative and office/admin words beat every pattern in the step, strong ones included (e.g. warehouse, mill, inter-warehouse, lot code, return to supplier); remaining false positives are labelled suggestions and confirmed by a person; office words block concept matches only, so a named gap (e.g. yield/loss report) is still found; negative/office entries with 'except' do not block concepts or gaps of those areas
